title: RobotDecisionEnvelope
description: A single task-level robot decision: what was believed, why an action was chosen, what happened, and any human correction. Observation-only; never a command.

decision_id.description: Stable unique id for this decision record (UUID).

action_goal_id.description: Reference to the executed action goal (e.g. a Nav2 goal id).

wall_time.description: ISO-8601 UTC wall-clock time of the decision.

monotonic_ns.description: Producer-local monotonic clock in nanoseconds; ordering within a source, immune to wall-clock skew.

source_seq.description: Per-source monotonic sequence number for gap detection and dedup.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key; a duplicate append with the same key is a no-op.

goal.description: The active goal this decision serves.

world_state_ref.description: Reference to external state/recording, not the raw data itself.

snapshot_hash.description: Content hash of the referenced world-state snapshot.

trace_ref.description: Reference into a rosbag2 / ros2_tracing recording.

constraints.description: Safety/operational rules in force at decision time.

decision_reason.description: Short factual reason (e.g. 'lowest feasible route cost'). Not an LLM narration.

software.description: Versions of the planner/policy/model/build that produced the decision.

human_override.description: If a human corrected or overrode the decision, what they did and why.
